title: Imbalanced Guard
wikitext:
{{Passive skill box|Imbalanced Guard}}

'''Imbalanced Guard''' is a [[keystone passive skill]] that doubles [[armour]] when defending against [[hit]]s, but caps [[damage reduction]] to 50%.

==Mechanics==
{{c|mod|100% chance to Defend with 200% of Armour}}: Similar modifiers, such as the {{c|mod|20% chance to Defend with 200% of Armour}} [[Armour Mastery]], do not stack with Imbalanced Guard.

{{c|mod|Maximum Damage Reduction for any Damage Type is 50%}}: This modifier lowers the cap on 'damage reduction' to 50%, from 90%. 

This affects damage reduction granted by [[armour]] against [[physical]] damage hits, ''additional'' sources such as {{c|mod|#% additional Physical Damage Reduction}} on [[strength]] body armours and shields, and damage reduction for non-physical damage gained from effects like [[Endurance charge]]s, {{psl|Transcendence}}, {{il|Doryani's Prototype}}, {{psl|Unbreakable}}, {{il|The Fourth Vow}}, or {{il|Eternal Damnation}}. 

The cap does not affect non-'damage reduction' mitigations such as [[immunity]], [[avoidance]], [[resistance]], [[damage taken]] modifiers (e.g. [[Fortification]]), [[spell suppression]], or [[block]].<ref>https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/h9rlc2/comment/fuykttl/</ref> 

==Strategy== 
Imbalanced Guard can cause armour to grant higher damage reduction against bigger hits, but limits armour's effectiveness against smaller hits. This may be useful for builds that stack several types of mitigation, rather than primarily stacking [[armour]] or additional damage reduction. 

==Location==
Imbalanced Guard is located at the middle layer of the southwest part of the tree, to the left of the transition path between [[Duelist]] and [[Marauder]], next to the {{psl|Soul of Steel}} cluster.
